name: Batamonisk
storyline: The Games Lore Involves a Demon King fighting a Holy Dragon. With the Dragon Inevitably Losing, This was many years before the Main Story takes place. But its said the Holy dragons soul Lurks around the area Called Batamonisk. Throughout the Story, You Play As A Man called Nakato (Pronounced Na- Kah-Toe) As he explores this new place. soon finding about its past and Defeating the Demon King with a few friends you find along the way.
summary:
Batamonisk is an exciting new game!

Genre: It’s a 2D RPG (role-playing game) where you play as a character named Nakato.

Gameplay: You explore various areas, loot items, and defeat enemies, which is typical of classic RPGs but with its unique twist.

Developer: The game is developed by Phxnix1 and made entirely in RPG Maker VX Ace.
